Module railyard_import

The module defines functions for obtaining railyard objects.

Currently it consists of one public function fromLayoutEditor that is used to import railyard from the layout editor.

Function Details

fromLayoutEditor(unlock=False, mutable=False, tolerance=5)

 

Return either a railyard object or a MutableRailyard object from the layout editor.

Parameters:
  • unlock (bool) - If true, the returning railyard is unlocked. The default is false.
  • mutable (bool) - If true, ignoring the value of unlock, the function returns a MutableRailyard object from which a railyard can be obtained (see MutableRailyard).
  • tolerance (int) - Distance tolerance when checking co-located objects.
Returns: IRailyard | MutableRailyard
Return either a railyard object if mutable is false, or a MutableRailyard object.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

orient_railyard(mutable_railyard, begin_nodes=None, begin_edges=None, verbose=False)

 

Orient a railyard

mutable_railyard is made oriented by propagating the orientation of the begin_edges and edges containing begin_nodes

Side effect: the "Positive" attribute of some edges in the mutable railyard will be modified

Parameters:
  • begin_nodes (maybe(list(Node)))
  • verbose (bool)
  • mutable_railyard (MutableRailyard)
  • begin_edges (maybe(list(Edges)))
